retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast charcoal-style portrait with dense crosshatching, framed by a solid yellow header and footer containing condensed typography.
excludeWhen: modern digital vector art is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a monochrome charcoal-drawn portrait of a man, rendered with aggressive diagonal crosshatching that creates deep shadows and highlights. The image is capped by a bright yellow horizontal bar at the top containing technical metadata and a primary title in yellow condensed type overlaid directly onto the dark illustration area.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the flat yellow header and the textured charcoal illustration
Relationship between the diagonal hatching direction and the subject's facial structure
Alignment of the primary title across the upper third of the dark image area
Balance between the dense black background and the light-toned face
coreInvariants: Monochrome subject on a dark background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait centered horizontally, slightly tilted, filling 80% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, defined by deep shadow and precise hatching.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the yellow header, drops to the high-contrast title, then follows the diagonal hatching down the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense, dark crosshatched background providing high contrast for the lighter facial tones.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white charcoal tones for the primary illustration.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for the header bar and title text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white highlights within the charcoal sketch.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the yellow and black; low saturation except for the primary yellow.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Narrow 'O' and 'C' with straight vertical sides
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and colors (yellow on black vs black on yellow).

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel and high impact of the display text.
Provides the clean, mid-century grotesque skeleton observed.
Captures the extreme verticality and flat sides of the characters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a monochrome charcoal drawing of a man's face using dense, aggressive diagonal crosshatching. The background should be nearly black with texture, and the face should be defined by lighter hatching. Add a solid bright yellow horizontal bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of ultra-condensed yellow sans-serif uppercase text across the upper third of the charcoal area. Add small black technical text and symbols centered within the top yellow bar.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait rendered with visible charcoal crosshatching?
Is the top header bar solid yellow?
Is the main title text ultra-condensed and yellow?

adjustableVariables: Width of the yellow header bar
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the textured background
Verify the crosshatching follows the contours of the face
Check that the yellow header is perfectly horizontal
Confirm the typography is strictly uppercase and condensed
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [Subject] and render in [Monochrome Charcoal Crosshatching] with [High Contrast Lighting]. Place a [Solid Yellow Bar] at the top and overlay [Ultra-Condensed Yellow Sans-Serif Text] across the upper third.
